errors.evidence: The description details the right Y-axis, which ranges from 45% to 65%. However, all three data series are plotted against the left Y-axis, which ranges from 15% to 45%.
The description completely fails to mention the existence and details of the left Y-axis (range 15% to 45%), which is the primary axis used for plotting all the data.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като "л.ск." (линейно скалиране)
errors.evidence: The abbreviation "л.ск." is part of the series names in the legend (e.g., "потребителски стоки (л.ск.)"), not a label for the Y-axis. The Y-axes are implicitly labeled with percentages (%).
The blue line is a solid line with no markers. The description invents round markers.

errors.text_span: Тя започва от 25% през 2008 г., спада до 23% през 2009 г., след което се покачва до 31% през 2010 г., спада до 26% през 2011 г., след това се покачва до 32% през 2012 г., след което спада до 28% през 2013 г., покачва се до 32% през 2014 г., и достига 28% през 2017 г.

The red line is described as dotted/dashed ("пунктирана"), but it is a solid line in the figure.
The red line is a solid line with no markers. The description invents triangular markers.
